BESS build time is 12-18 months; to make 2028-03-01 COD, groundbreaking would need to begin by ~Sep 2026 — no construction, EPC, or financing announcement exists as of Jul-2026 that supports this.
Meets all 6.9 conditions NOT yet satisfied as of Jun-2026, despite 6.9(1) met Feb-2025; unknown blocking condition. Full 6.9 is required before commercial operation.
Developer website is stale: claims 550 MW capacity (vs 362 MW in queue) and 'end of 2025' target COD (2.7 years behind actual queue COD). Suggests low internal communications priority.
No financing announcement, no EPC named, no PPA/offtake announced, no community engagement — all absent from public developer communications.

Sibling project 25INR0421 (Aldrin 138 BESS) also in queue at same Meadow substation — two simultaneous interconnection requests at the same POI suggests ongoing configuration iteration rather than final committed design.

Positive signals: IA signed Jun-2024 (institutional commitment from CenterPoint), FIS approved Apr-2025, 6.9(1) met Feb-2025. Vesper Energy is credible (Hornet Solar COD Apr 2025, Nazareth Solar financed Jun 2026 for $236M); not a paper-project mill.
Independent estimate 2028-Q4 to 2029-Q2 assumes financing closes by late 2026 and groundbreaking follows promptly; significant further drift possible if capital raise is delayed.
